parts.text: The INTERACT Animal Lab at Northeastern University is recruiting a PhD student for Fall 2027 through the Interdisciplinary Design and Media program. The research involves designing, prototyping, and evaluating interactive technologies that support animal agency and wellbeing.
The program lists 1 December 2026 as its application deadline for Fall 2027. Candidates with experience in interaction design, computing, or prototyping are encouraged to apply.
